categories.main_business_segments: Nexchip Semiconductor Corporation primarily engages in 12-inch wafer foundry services and related supporting services. The company offers wafer foundry across multiple process nodes including 150nm to 55nm, with small-batch production at 40nm and ongoing development at 28nm. Its product portfolio includes Display Driver ICs (DDIC), CMOS Image Sensors (CIS), Power Management ICs (PMIC), Microcontroller Units (MCU), and Logic ICs, serving applications in smartphones, displays, automotive electronics, home appliances, industrial control, and IoT.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced semiconductor manufacturing technologies including copper and aluminum process technologies, BSI (Back Side Illumination), stacked CIS chip platforms, and embedded flash microcontrollers. It has achieved mass production at 55nm and above nodes, small-batch production at 40nm for high-voltage OLED display drivers, and functional verification of 28nm logic chips. The manufacturing process includes strict R&D management, wafer fabrication, and photomask manufacturing, supported by intelligent manufacturing systems and AI integration.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nexchip serves leading domestic and international semiconductor design companies and end-product manufacturers. Its key markets include consumer electronics such as smartphones and tablets, automotive electronics, industrial automation, security, and IoT devices. The company maintains close, long-term relationships with major customers, including some top-tier global firms, and actively expands both domestic and overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered and primarily operates in Hefei, Anhui Province, China, within the Hefei Comprehensive Bonded Zone. It serves customers domestically across China and internationally, with subsidiaries and investments in Japan and other locations. Its overseas operations include a wholly owned subsidiary in Japan and business dealings with global clients.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nexchip operates in the midstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a wafer foundry service provider. It manufactures semiconductor wafers for integrated circuit design companies, focusing on fabrication and photomask production. The company collaborates closely with upstream suppliers of raw materials and equipment and downstream customers in chip design and end-product manufacturing.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on advancing process nodes (notably 40nm and 28nm), expanding product platforms (OLED drivers, CIS, PMIC, MCU, Logic), and developing automotive-grade chips. It emphasizes innovation in microdisplay technologies for AR/VR, power management, and automotive electronics. Nexchip also invests in talent development, intelligent manufacturing, and domestic supply chain localization to enhance competitiveness and support emerging markets like AI, 5G, and new energy vehicles.
categories.revenue_model: Nexchip generates revenue primarily through direct sales of wafer foundry services and related photomask manufacturing. It operates mainly on a direct sales model with contracts and orders from semiconductor design companies and end customers. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control of goods at a point in time, with pricing based on contract terms and adjusted for variable considerations such as sales rebates.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company ranks as the third largest wafer foundry in mainland China and ninth globally by revenue in 2024. It holds a leading global market share in LCD panel display driver chip foundry. Competitors include major global foundries like TSMC and other Chinese foundries. Nexchip differentiates itself through mature process technologies, diversified product platforms, strong customer relationships, and integration within the Hefei semiconductor ecosystem.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Nexchip achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 9.25 billion, a 27.69% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 532.8 million, up 151.78%. The company maintains a strong R&D investment ratio (~13.88% of revenue) and has steadily increased production capacity and product diversity. Total assets reached RMB 50.4 billion with a slight increase from the previous year, reflecting ongoing capital expenditures and expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nexchip emphasizes its comprehensive process technology platforms, including mature nodes and emerging advanced nodes, enabling diverse applications from consumer electronics to automotive. Its value lies in stable, high-quality wafer foundry services, strong R&D capabilities, and integration with a robust local semiconductor ecosystem. The company also highlights its commitment to supply chain security through domestic localization, intelligent manufacturing, and close customer collaboration to deliver tailored, innovative semiconductor solutions.
